title: Splitnir

infobox.Crafting Materials: Ashwood x15, Flametal x18, Asksvin hide x3, Bonemaw tooth x9

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Splitnir is the sixth spear. Its primary attack is a thrust. Its secondary attack throws the spear for 1.5x damage.
Like most Ashlands-tier weapons, the Splitnir can be upgraded to one of the following three variants using gemstones:
• Splitnir the Bleeding (Bloodstone)
• Splitnir the Storming (Iolite)
• Splitnir the Primal (Jade)
An upgraded Splitnir will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
